text_block_list.text:
The Senior Class year with Katsuragi Ace
has finally begun—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOO!!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Alright! How was that!?
choice_data_list: That's the target time...! We did it!!
That's the target time...! We did it!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah!
Off to a great start right at the beginning of the year~!

Katsuragi Ace didn't go home this year either,
continuing to train relentlessly through the New Year holidays...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer!
—The sound of our high five with Katsuragi Ace echoed pleasantly across the early morning track.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright. Well then,
should we head out since we've hit a good stopping point?
—After early morning training, I went with Katsuragi Ace, who had changed clothes, to make our first shrine visit of the year at a nearby shrine.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, it's packed, totally packed!
New Year's Day really hits different~.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Let's line up quick and get this over with!
Then we can go eat!
choice_data_list: Feels more like going for the food than the shrine visit.
Feels more like going for the food than the shrine visit.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haha, busted! Can ya blame me?
I've been workin' my butt off since morning!
And so, while making idle conversation, we lined up for the shrine visit—
Standing side by side, the two of us finished our prayers.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—The line moved way faster than I expected, thank goodness.
Looks like I'll actually have time to enjoy my food.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Still, you were praying for quite a while, Trainer~
What on earth did you wish for?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Huh, my health!?
I appreciate it, but at times like this,
you should make a wish for yourself!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Geez, if I'd known, I should've prayed
for your good health instead, Trainer.
Well, let's both take good care of ourselves from now on!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Huh, my growth!?
I appreciate it, but at times like this,
you should make a wish for yourself!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Still, since you prayed for me, I can't settle for half-baked growth.
I'm definitely gonna blow past your expectations, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Huh, me!?
And for good luck, you say—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haha! You were praying for that long?!
You sure do some weird things, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, let's test our luck right away!
Let's go draw some fortunes!
—And so, Katsuragi Ace and I wrapped up a delightful New Year's shrine visit.
Afterward, while having lunch at a nearby restaurant—

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text: ""Last year was another turbulent time for the Twinkle Series, giving birth to numerous legendary races—""

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Oh, a special program is on.

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"—Symboli Rudolf, who debuted last year!
Living up to all the hype, she is already considered the top contender for this year's Classic Triple Crown!"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"'She's also very eager to take on the Classic Triple Crown route,
and has already boldly declared that she will become a Triple Crown Umamusume...!'"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text: ""Following Mr. C.B., who drew so much attention last year, we might witness another historic performance this year as well!""

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text: "Among the more passionate fans, fierce debates are already sparking over who is stronger: C.B. or Rudolf—"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "...That's Rudolf for you. Everyone's already buzzing about it."

—The “Emperor,” Symboli Rudolf.
A once-in-a-generation prodigy, the pride of the venerable Symboli family.

She is extraordinary both as an athlete and as a student,
and her raw talent on the track is so immense that she is said
to be destined for the "Triple Crown."

She enters the Classic division this year, and depending on how things unfold,
she might even cross paths with Katsuragi Ace before the year is out—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—This is the year I have to step up
and stake my claim as the strongest at medium distance.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
So I can't let myself lose to Rudolf, either...!
Let's get fired up!

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting! One mega-portion special ramen
and a double gyoza-karaage-fried rice combo!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Here it comes!

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
And here is our limited-time special,
the Ramen Kiwami!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Seeing it in person,
yours looks delicious too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Seriously!? I'll eat it, I'll eat it!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ah, then I'll make up for mine too!
Fried chicken? Gyoza?
Fried rice or ramen works too. Heck, how 'bout all of 'em!
choice_data_list: I think I'd like to choose, please...!

text_block_list.text:
With a fresh mindset—
The battles of the Senior Year begin!!
